risks.title: Cybersecurity and system disruption risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the operational risks section. A structured crisis management plan is in place. Potential consequences include financial, regulatory, and reputational impacts, indicating high severity.

risks.title: Regulatory and customs risks related to ethylene oxide
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in the Business section. The EPA has issued an interim decision strictly regulating the use of EtO in medical sterilization, with phase-out periods and phased compliance obligations over several years. Significant operational and financial impact on customers and potentially on Balchem.

risks.title: EU anti-dumping duties on choline chloride
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Recent Developments. The EU imposed definitive duties between 90.0% and 115.9% on choline chloride imports in July 2025, with clear rules of origin. Significant and direct financial impact on affected operations and European customers.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Legal Proceedings. Balchem is regularly involved in various commercial, contractual, employment, product, and environmental litigations. Although the company believes current matters will not have a material effect, the diversity of litigations justifies moderate severity.

risks.title: Dependence on macroeconomic and competitive conditions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in MD&A of the Net Sales section. Future performance may fluctuate based on general economic conditions, competitive dynamics, and customer preferences. This highlights sensitivity to external factors.

risks.title: Manufacturing input cost risks
risks.score_rationale: Indicated in MD&A of Gross Margin. The increase in gross margin was partially offset by higher manufactured input costs. While currently managed, a significant escalation could affect profitability.

ai_positioning.summary: Balchem Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report. The company focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialty performance ingredients for nutritional, pharmaceutical, and industrial markets, with no explicit reference to AI or related technologies.
